scope: Alpha white; original-wording reconstruction; development experiment, not a released default.

profile.policy: One shared legal period and existing ink separation; material-specific strength and variation; training mean RGB error cannot rise by more than 1/255 relative to no dots.

metric.name: Native-pixel phase-independent spectral-amplitude mismatch
metric.normalization: Frozen card affine transforms; map scan frequency vectors with inverse-transpose Jacobian. Neither image is resampled for this texture metric.
metric.patches: Frame 16x32, paper 32x32, inner border 6x32; up to six clean nonoverlapping patches per card/material; average patches per card then cards.
metric.filters: Remove sigma 1.25 pixel low frequencies; Hann-windowed FFT; five radial bands and four angular bins; luminance and two opponent-color channels weighted 0.7,0.15,0.15.
metric.selection: 34-card mean; one period shared by materials; existing shader; mean RGB error rise limited to 1/255 per material. Comparison cards not used in selection.

limitations: Comparison group was inspected in earlier experiments; it is not independent validation.
This fits the cached scan appearance including scanning and compression, not physical press measurements.
Only Alpha white tested; do not make these defaults for other frames or resolutions.
Dark-band chroma still has lower contrast than scans; the tested lower black-generation settings did not improve the fit.
Cardstock relief and gloss are visual settings, not calibrated from flat scans.
Do not substitute the spectral diagnostic for whole-card structure, typography or color accuracy.

previewVerification.status: Ready · print dots on the frame · cardstock and gloss across the whole card
